scripts.setup: npm run db:create && npm run db:create:api && npm run migrate:auth
scripts.db:create: dotenv -e development.env -- xeplr-migrate create-db --connectionName auth --connection-env AUTH_DB_CONNECTION_INFO_ENCRYPTED --db-env AUTH_DB_NAME
scripts.db:create:api: dotenv -e development.env -- xeplr-migrate create-db --connectionName api --connection-env XEPLR_MONITOR_CONNECTION --db-env DB_API
scripts.migrate:up: dotenv -e development.env -- xeplr-migrate up --dir ./migrations --connectionName api --connection-env XEPLR_MONITOR_CONNECTION
